coverageNotes: Naturkartan exposes per-stage GPX for all 10 sections; coordinate order matches official Hindås-to-Mullsjö order.
Borås SWEREF coordinates converted WGS84 generally agree; keep both where already captured.
Naturkartan says whole Sjuhäradsleden not fully quality-assured by trail manager Västkuststiftelsen; keep visible until newer official source.

geometryPlan.primarySource: Naturkartan per-section GPX/API for all sections, preserving official stage order and section-to-section continuity.
geometryPlan.secondarySource: OSM relations are cross-checks for topology, endpoint sanity and related-route overlaps. Do not replace Naturkartan geometry with OSM unless an explicit geometry QA task decides to do so.
geometryPlan.distancePolicy: Use official section metadata for display where already captured and retain computed geometry metadata for QA.
geometryPlan.endpointAndAccessPolicy: Keep route-line endpoints from Naturkartan for geometry continuity; model named trailheads, parking, clubhouses, hotels, campgrounds, churches/transit as separate access/facility clusters with route-proximity metadata.

sectionSpecificActions.action: Normalize the Rölle duplicate/parallel/spur artifacts into one mainline before import. Do not use the Rölle partial-segment coordinate as an endpoint.
Densify/resample the known 838.6 m simplified chord before import. Keep the Naturkartan official route corridor and do not snap endpoint display directly to Prångens Camping access objects.
Preserve or explicitly bridge the three Naturkartan GPX components and reverse OSM if used. Treat the Borås stage-8 Böne easting 4120226 as a typo and use 412026 for Borås-derived Böne metadata.

Use Naturkartan GPX/API as planning-grade primary geometry. OSM relation 5607240 is continuous but stored in reverse order and locally deviates from Naturkartan by up to about 100 m; reverse and use only as cross-check/overlap source.

unknowns: unknown/recheck: final production GIS clipping for all facility points and route segments.
unknown/recheck: final normalized route distance after section 6 cleanup and section 7 densification.

policy: Do not import springs, church taps, lake water or service-facility water as potable unless a current source explicitly confirms public drinking-water access. Natural water can be mapped as natural/bathing/rest context only.

Keep route-line endpoints from Naturkartan for geometry continuity; model named trailheads, parking, clubhouses, hotels, campgrounds, churches/transit as separate access/facility clusters with route-proximity metadata.
Verify public access/opening status for service facilities before exposing water/toilet/cafe/lodging.
candidateImports: Import high-confidence access/facility clusters already resolved in section packets after proximity and protected-area clipping.
Carry service/guest-only water metadata for Ryfors Golfklubb, Mullsjö Camping, Årås and similar service facilities unless public drinking-water access is confirmed.
pendingOrSuppressedFacilities: Ryfors Golfklubb/Mullsjö Camping service/guest metadata only.
Suppress Struntfiskeboa firepit under Årås reserve no-fire rule.
Trollsjön fireplace only if official designated place.
Mullsjö Friluftshotellet confirmed access metadata but live schedule refresh.

dynamicPublicationChecks: Refresh fire-ban status for Härryda, Bollebygd, Borås, Ulricehamn, Mullsjö before publication.
Production GIS clipping all facility points/route segments.
Verify public access/opening status for service facilities before exposing water/toilet/cafe/lodging.

importOrder: 1. Import/parse section research packets in official section order.
2. Build Naturkartan-primary route geometry and preserve section boundaries.
3. Apply section 6 Rölle cleanup, section 7 chord densification, section 8 component handling, and section 10 OSM reversal only for QA if used.
4. Build endpoint and access/facility clusters without snapping route-line endpoints to services.
5. Run protected-area clipping for route segments and facility points.
6. Promote only verified facilities; keep pending/suppressed/service-only facilities out of public normalized facilities.
7. Attach rule warnings and dynamic publication-day checks.
8. Validate normalized research output before any runtime/public data import.

blockers.description: Run geometry normalization/densification for section 6 and 7 before runtime route import.
Production GIS clipping all facility points/route segments.
Refresh fire-ban status for Härryda, Bollebygd, Borås, Ulricehamn, Mullsjö before publication; refresh Västtrafik/JLT schedules/stops before publication.
Verify public access/opening status for service facilities before exposing water/toilet/cafe/lodging.

openDecisionsForUser.decision: Keep the Naturkartan/Västkuststiftelsen not-fully-quality-assured caveat visible in the app until newer official source.
Allow natural water/lake/spring features as natural/bathing/rest context while suppressing potable-water status.
Keep Struntfiskeboa shelter pending/unofficial rather than promoting as a normal shelter until verification.

validationChecklist: No runtime app data, generated public data, shared scripts, or package files changed.
All 10 section files are represented in sectionCoverage.
Naturkartan remains primary geometry source; OSM remains QA/cross-check only.
Section 6, 7, 8, and 10 geometry caveats are carried into geometryPlan.
Facility water policy suppresses unverified potable-water imports.
Protected-area and fire/transit currentness checks remain publication-day blockers.

statusDetails.summary: Overview and sections 1-10 are complete enough for normalization review. Caveats have explicit decisions or import-day deferrals in caveat-resolution.research.json. Keep research-only until normalization, protected-area clipping, live transit/fire refreshes, and facility verification are complete.
